newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's UES net profit edges up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Russia's UES net profit edges up in 1996.

text.p: Net profits at national power company Unified Energy System (UES) rose to 469 billion roubles in 1996 from 422 billion in 1995, a UES official said on Thursday.

The official, quoting figures approved at the latest meeting of the UES board, said the profit, on an accruals basis to Russian accounting standards, applied to the parent company only and was not consolidated.
The UES official said the board had preliminarily decided to recommend a dividend of five roubles for every 50-rouble nominal ordinary and common share to registered owners as of April 20.
The board finalised details of the annual meeting, which will be held in Konakovo, near Moscow on May 30, he said.
UES's shares had firmed to $0.2115 at 1255 GMT on the Russian Trading System from $0.2109 at the close on Wednesday.

Note: These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
